cause: WebLLM 0.2.85 reads enable_thinking from request.extra_body; the initial caller passed it at top level. Raw first-position scoring therefore did not reliably follow the empty thinking prefix.
correction: Use extra_body: {enable_thinking: false}, as verified in pinned engine source; then reload and rerun browser smoke.
scope: Browser integration smoke, separate from all Doom research runs. No benchmark or calibration claim.
